tailoring.headline: AI Engineer & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring, Generative AI
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices, and data integration between PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven record of AI-assisted analysis, development and documentation, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, and techno-functional consulting with international stakeholders, driving continuous improvement and ensuring high performance.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Konecranes AI Engineer, SAP Commerce
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Konecranes’ vision to embed AI into its lifting solutions and to advance SAP Commerce platforms. With over five years designing and delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep e-commerce expertise with AI-assisted development to drive innovative, data-rich applications.

bullets.label: **AI-assisted development**
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I leveraged generative AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, code generation and documentation, cutting development cycles by up to 30% while maintaining quality.

bullets.label: **SAP Commerce integration**
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) and integrated SAP ERP and MDM systems, ensuring seamless product catalog synchronization.

bullets.label: **REST & OCC APIs**
bullets.text: Built robust OCC REST web services and micro-services in Java Spring Boot for headless commerce, enabling third-party and storefront consumption across global markets.

bullets.label: **Scalable cloud deployment**
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD pipelines on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Docker and Kubernetes, delivering reliable cloud deployments and rapid hot-fixes.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Konecranes.

tailoring.why_company: Konecranes is a global leader in lifting solutions, and its commitment to integrating AI into its software stack aligns perfectly with my passion for AI-assisted development. I am eager to apply my deep SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and proven AI-driven delivery methods to create smarter, more efficient digital services that enhance Konecranes’ products and customer experience, driving the next wave of intelligent automation.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to combine my SAP Commerce expertise with AI to help Konecranes deliver smarter, data-driven lifting solutions, leveraging my proven track record in AI-assisted development and large-scale e-commerce integrations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years experience and AI-assisted delivery expertise. I’m excited about Konecranes’ AI vision and would love to discuss how I can contribute. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for AI Engineer, SAP Commerce – Konecranes
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the AI Engineer, SAP Commerce position at Konecranes. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud development for Rockwell Automation and Shell, and extensive AI-assisted delivery experience, I am eager to help shape your AI-driven software solutions. I am available to start on 16 December 2026. Thank you for your consideration.
